title: AI for Graphic Design: Week Challenge

questions.q: What does good contrast do in a design?
options: Makes things stand out and easy to read

questions.q: What is the safest number of fonts to use in one design?
What does visual hierarchy tell the viewer?
Why must you always check AI's work?
Which colours are the three traditional primary colours?
What does saturation describe?
options: How vivid or dull a colour is

questions.q: What is the 60-30-10 rule?
options: Main colour, second colour, accent colour

questions.q: What is the minimum contrast ratio for normal text (WCAG)?
What is a prompt?
options: The instruction you give an AI

questions.q: Which is a strong image prompt?
options: Flat vector illustration of a smiling woman in a salon, warm orange and teal, space for text, no text

questions.q: Why should you say 'no text' in an AI image prompt?
options: AI often garbles letters, so add text yourself in Canva
Text is not allowed in posters

questions.q: Before selling AI-made images to a client, what should you check?
options: The tool's licence for commercial use
Nothing, free means free to sell

questions.q: Which file type gives a logo with a transparent background?
Which colour mode is right for professional printing?
What does AI upscaling do?
options: Enlarges a picture and adds detail

questions.q: Which of these is a good logo check?
options: Works in black and white and stays readable small
Only looks good on a poster

questions.q: What should a portfolio contain?
options: Your 3 to 6 best pieces with short notes

questions.q: Where is the best place to find your first client?
options: Anyone who asks you to pay a fee first

questions.q: A 'client' asks you to pay a fee before giving you work. What do you do?
options: Walk away: it is a scam warning sign

questions.q: What is a brand kit?
options: Logo, colours, fonts and rules that keep designs consistent
